decided.singular: Extreme max values stand alone (117.0, 114.0, 96.0) and precipitous drops between consecutive days (114.0→18.0) plus isolated deep valleys (8.0).
decided.highest: Q2 contains the two absolute highest single-day max values in the entire year: day 121 (117.0) and day 135 (114.0).
decided.lowest: Q3 maintains consistently lower mean values throughout the quarter (mostly 10-20 range) compared to all other quarters.
decided.recurrence: Gaps between major elevation periods are irregular—~12 days (68-69 to 80), ~14 days (121 to 135), ~40+ days (135 to 174)—showing no consistent 5-10 day cycle.

answer.guess: Solar activity (sunspot count) or similar episodic astrophysical phenomenon.
